question: How many vacation days does a full-time employee get each year?
reference_answer: Full-time employees accrue 18 days of annual paid leave per year, credited in a lump sum at the start of each calendar year.

question: How many unused leave days can be carried over to next year?
reference_answer: Up to 5 days of unused leave may be carried over into the next calendar year; any balance above that is forfeited unless local law requires otherwise.

question: How many days per week are employees allowed to work from home?
reference_answer: Employees may work remotely up to 3 days per week, subject to manager approval and role suitability.

question: Above what expense amount is a receipt required?
reference_answer: Any expense over $50 requires an itemized receipt submitted through the expense portal within 30 days of purchase.

question: Is a VPN required to access internal systems from outside the office?
reference_answer: Yes, VPN access is mandatory for any connection to internal systems from outside the office network.

question: What is the default rate limit for the Aurora API Gateway?
reference_answer: The gateway enforces a default rate limit of 1000 requests per minute per API key.

question: What authentication methods does Aurora support for service-to-service calls?
reference_answer: Aurora supports OAuth2 client-credentials flow and static API keys for service-to-service calls.

question: Which regions is the Aurora API Gateway deployed in?
reference_answer: Aurora is currently deployed in two regions: US-East and EU-West.

question: How much does the Pro pricing tier cost per month?
reference_answer: The Pro tier costs $99 per month and includes 1,000,000 requests, both regions, and a 99.9 percent uptime SLA.

question: How many free requests per month are included in the Free tier?
reference_answer: The Free tier includes 10,000 requests per month at no cost, with access to US-East only and no SLA guarantee.

question: How many charge-discharge cycles were used in the battery test?
reference_answer: Cells were cycled through 500 full charge-discharge cycles.

question: At what temperature was the battery degradation test conducted?
reference_answer: The cells were cycled at a controlled ambient temperature of 25 degrees Celsius.

question: At what capacity retention percentage is a battery cell considered end-of-life?
reference_answer: A cell was classified as end-of-life once its capacity fell below an 80 percent retention threshold relative to its rated capacity.

question: What capacity did the new electrolyte formulation retain after the test cycles?
reference_answer: The new electrolyte formulation retained an average of 87 percent capacity after 500 cycles.

question: What capacity did the baseline formulation retain under the same test conditions?
reference_answer: The baseline formulation retained an average of 74 percent capacity after 500 cycles under identical test conditions.
